title: Simultaneous Envy and Equitability Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2608.26410v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work in fair division has focused on either simultaneously satisfying closely related fairness notions or achieving a single notion across the ex-ante and ex-post worlds. We study the compatibility of two fundamentally different fairness notions: envy-freeness and equitability. For indivisible goods-only and chores-only settings, we study the existence and complexity of simultaneously satisfying their relaxations, revealing sharp contrasts between the two settings. We show that EF1+EQ1 may fail to exist even for normalized, additive valuations. Our main algorithmic result computes an EF1+EQ1 allocation for normalized binary goods with at most seven agents. In sharp contrast, binary chores admit the stronger EFX+EQX guarantee for any number of agents, even without normalization. We further initiate the study of cross-notion ex-ante--ex-post guarantees, asking whether randomized allocations can provide ex-ante guarantees for one n

translated_title: 同时实现嫉妒自由与公平性保证
translated_abstract: 近期公平分配领域的研究聚焦于同时满足密切相关公平概念，或在事前（ex-ante）和事后（ex-post）世界中实现单一概念。我们研究了两种根本不同的公平概念——嫉妒自由（envy-freeness）和公平性（equitability）——之间的兼容性。对于不可分割的纯商品和纯家务场景，我们研究了同时满足其松弛版本的可行性和复杂性，揭示了两种场景之间的鲜明对比。我们证明，即使对于归一化、加性估值，EF1+EQ1也可能不存在。我们的主要算法结果为归一化二元商品在最多七个代理的情况下计算出一个EF1+EQ1分配。与此形成鲜明对比的是，二元家务在任意代理数量下都允许更强的EFX+EQX保证，甚至无需归一化。我们进一步启动了跨概念的事前-事后保证研究，探讨随机分配是否能为一个概念提供事前保证。
tldr: 本文研究了公平分配中嫉妒自由与公平性两种概念的同时满足，揭示了商品与家务场景的差异，并提出了二元商品和家务场景下的分配算法及保证。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates the compatibility of envy-freeness and equitability in fair division, revealing contrasts between goods and chores settings, and provides algorithms and guarantees for binary valuations.
